notes: Every prop is optional: <Clock /> draws a local-time clock on the default face.
Props left out keep the watch face's own design; props you pass always win over the face.
Option lists are also exported for pickers: CLOCK_FACES, SECOND_HAND_MOTIONS, SECOND_HAND_STYLES, DATE_FORMATS, DIAL_NUMBERS, DIAL_NUMERALS, DIAL_MARKERS and DIAL_MINUTE_TICKS.

props.name: face
props.description: Watch face: shapes, markers and colours.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colour scheme of the dial. Every face has a light and a dark version.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the dial in pixels. The SVG is radius * 2 + 36 px square (room for the shadow).

props.name: label
props.description: Text on the dial, shown in capitals, e.g. a city name. Hidden when radius is below 50.

props.name: timezone
props.description: IANA time zone. An invalid zone falls back to local time.

props.name: showDigital
props.description: Show the digital time below the dial.

props.name: timeFormat
props.description: Format of the digital time.

props.name: dateFormat
props.description: Date shown in the clock's time zone, below the clock in the digital time colour (or on the dial with dateInside).

props.name: dateInside
props.description: Draw the date inside the dial, in the lower half (in the label colour), instead of below the clock. Falls back to below the clock when radius < 50.

props.name: showSeconds
props.description: Show the second hand, and seconds in the digital time.

props.name: secondHandMotion
props.description: How the second hand moves. bounce, ease and anticipate fall back to tick when the user's system asks for reduced motion.

values.label: Mechanical sweep
values.description: 8 small steps per second, like an automatic watch.

values.label: Stop-to-go
values.description: One lap in 58 s, a 2 s pause at 12, then the minute hand jumps.

values.label: Spring bounce
values.description: Springs to each second, overshoots and settles.

values.label: Ease-in-out tick
values.description: Soft ease-in-out move to each second.

values.label: Anticipation tick
values.description: Dips back slightly, then snaps forward.

props.name: secondHandStyle
props.description: How the second hand looks. Every style except face is drawn without the face's counterweight. Object styles are named <shape>-<fill>.

values.label: Face default
values.description: The watch face's own second hand.

values.label: Tapered
values.description: Widest at the tail, narrowing to a fine tip.

props.name: secondHandMarkerAt
props.description: Where the object sits along the second hand: 0 is flush with the inner end (the tail past the centre), 100 flush with the tip. Values outside 0-100 are clamped. Only used by object styles.

props.name: numbers
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's own design is used.
props.description: Which hours get a number.

props.name: numerals
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's own design is used.
props.description: How numbers are written.

props.name: rotateNumbers
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's own design is used.
props.description: Turn each number so its top faces the edge.

props.name: mainMarker
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's own design is used.
props.description: Markers at 12, 3, 6 and 9. Drawn a little bolder than the other hours.

props.name: marker12
props.defaultNote: Not set: same as mainMarker (or the face's own 12 o'clock marker).
props.description: Marker at 12 only, e.g. a triangle with bars elsewhere.

props.name: hourMarker
props.defaultNote: Not set: same as mainMarker (or the face's own hour markers).
props.description: Markers at the other 8 hours.

props.name: minuteTicks
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's own design is used.
props.description: Ticks for the minutes between the hours.

values.label: Railway track
values.description: Ticks between two thin rings, like a station clock.

values.label: Rainbow
values.description: Coloured by position around the dial.

props.name: hideMarkersAtNumbers
props.defaultNote: Not set: the face decides. When numbers are added to a face whose markers run through the same ring (like gold), the markers under the numbers are hidden.
props.description: Leave out the marker wherever a number is drawn.

props.name: borderColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Bezel (case) colour. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: dialColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Dial colour. The edge is shaded slightly darker so the dial keeps its gradient. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: tickColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Markers and ticks. Minute ticks are drawn lighter. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: numberColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Numbers on the dial. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: hourHandColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Hour hand and centre cap. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: minuteHandColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Minute hand. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: secondHandColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the face's colour (#e03a3a on the default face).
props.description: Second hand and centre dot. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

props.name: digitalColor
props.defaultNote: Not set: the watch face's colour is used.
props.description: Digital time text. Any CSS colour, e.g. "#1f5133", "rgb(31 81 51)" or "teal". Overrides the face.

example.description: Gold face, black dial, Roman numerals at the quarters, triangle at 12, ringed second hand near the tip.
example.jsx: <Clock face="gold" dialColor="#151515" numberColor="#d4af37" numbers="quarters" numerals="roman" mainMarker="bar" marker12="triangle-in" secondHandStyle="circle-outline" secondHandMarkerAt={90} secondHandMotion="sweep" />
